notes.text:
The immutable mathematical binder supplies exactly five authorized whole grant groups A224, B225, R230, S262 and S272, including every clarification. All 22 mathematical packet bodies were read completely in bounded local chunks. All 26 mathematical-packet and original-primary byte bindings matched. ROOT276/277/278/281 remain unreviewed working data; only the needed ROOT278 arguments are independently reconstructed in n2. Native210's overall evidence verdict remains INCONCLUSIVE. No authority is inferred from historical execution.

The granted assumptions used below have these domains. X is finite, pure, globally embedded in a lattice real vector space, rational, and carries specified positive balanced real top weights. Tangent lattices are saturated. PA_Z has integral slopes and rational constants; PA_R has arbitrary real coefficients on finite rational geometry. Printed PC uses rational endpoints, real nonnegative barycentric weights, and a center face contained in every endpoint cell. R230 identifies the unrestricted envelope for continuous PC gamma and bounded continuous u with a continuous real-endpoint PC envelope, satisfying |P_gamma(u)-gamma|<=||u||. This identification does not supply regularization.

For inward saturated primitive normals, the raw recursion is D_f c(tau)=sum_sigma c(sigma)f_sigma(n_sigma/tau)-f_tau(sum_sigma c(sigma)n_sigma/tau). S262/S272 supply genuine finite real recursion, signed and zero intermediate cycles, refinement independence, mixed symmetry, positivity for PC intersections, bounded primitive-edge integration by parts, and common relative mass M=deg(gamma). There is no appended factorial. The finite-PA noncontact-to-flat-relation argument requires PC. S272 supplies actual-reference realization of rational homogeneous PC jets on specified finite rational tangent refinements, preserving flatness and scaling top mass by delta^d, followed by an exact finite-PA roof witness.

S272 supplies an operator only on D_R(gamma), the global uniform/decreasing completion of actual relative real-PA PC functions. It supplies same-reference compact-test DC auxiliaries and a proper rational-component height H0 with moment bound K_C=(2d/epsilon)CM+J0 for every completed mixed tuple of each fixed relative bound C. Global uniformity is vague; weak/net continuity is ordinary; weak/BL uniformity is only on fixed-C families. These restrictions are retained. B225's embedded noncompactness and S262's noncompact literal regularity obstruction remain separate context. No literal measure is assigned to an excluded endpoint. A224 is retained in its exact fan-specific scope.

These are authorized assumptions, not new acceptance claims. Four original primary files and the whole pertinent immediate proof units were bound and checked. The source-application ledger records exact applications, primitive/unit-normal calibration, and recursive foundations not freshly reconstructed. Broad source PA density, automatic rational-endpoint continuity, delegated AR10 claims and analytic MA replacement are not used.

notes.summary: Complete rational affine spaces admit global real-PA regularization of all continuous relative convex functions and exact raw contact for every bounded continuous obstacle, retaining arbitrary real reference coefficients.
notes.detailedSummary: A rational-position epigraph construction using the exact actual recession cone yields globally uniform convex majorants on rational geometry. Compact dual continuity proves the error bound. Finite contact follows from flat-relation lineality; reconstructed legal-tree and localized genuine-domain continuity pass contact to non-PA obstacles. General singular regularization remains open.
notes.text:
New scoped theorem. Let X be a complete rational affine d-plane, d>=1, with constant positive weight and saturated lattice. Let gamma be an actual real-PA PC reference on finite rational geometry, positive at infinity. Every continuous convex f with f-gamma bounded has global decreasing real-PA approximants on rational geometry. Consequently every bounded continuous obstacle has a genuinely completed unrestricted envelope and exact raw contact integral zero. This is an all-continuous affine theorem, not the general singular classification.

Identify X with R^d using a rational origin and saturated basis. Every finite continuous convex function has a supporting affine plane at every point: separate its closed epigraph from (x,f(x)-t) by the nearest-point normal and let t decrease to zero. A limiting horizontal supporting normal would pair with every base direction and therefore vanish, so the limiting vertical component is positive. Division gives support planes and f(x)=sup_p(p.x-f*(p)), where f*(p)=sup_x(p.x-f(x)).

A finite convex PA reference is gamma=max_i(p_i.x+b_i), because each interior-cell gradient supplies a global support. Put Delta=conv{p_i} and h(v)=max_i p_i.v. Gamma-h is bounded. Its rational carrying complex supplies rational recession generators r_j, including both signs of lineality directions, satisfying epi h=cone{(r_j,h(r_j)),(0,1)} and Delta={p:p.r_j<=h(r_j) for all j}. The recession cones cover R^d: every ray has an unbounded subsequence in one of finitely many cells, and division of its defining inequalities shows that the direction belongs to that cell's recession cone. On each cone h is linear. These observations prove the cone identities. Positive growth gives h(v)>0 for v!=0.

If ||f-gamma||<=C, then gamma*-C<=f*<=gamma*+C. Both conjugates have domain Delta. For p=sum t_i p_i, gamma(x)>=p.x+sum t_i b_i bounds gamma*(p) above; evaluation at zero bounds it below. Separation gives infinity outside Delta. Hence f* is finite, bounded, convex and lower semicontinuous on the compact polytope Delta, possibly irrational.

Such a function is continuous even at its polytope boundary. At p choose finitely many tangent-cone generators v_i and anchors p+eta v_i in Delta. Every nearby y has y-p=sum a_i v_i, a_i>=0, with sum a_i<=A||y-p||: eliminate dependent active columns and bound inverses over the finitely many independent subsets. For sufficiently small distances this expresses y as a convex combination of p and the fixed anchors. Convexity gives f*(y)<=f*(p)+A'||y-p||; lower semicontinuity gives the reverse limiting inequality.

Continuity of f implies f*(p)=sup_{x rational}(p.x-f(x)). At each p choose a rational sample within eta of the supremum. Continuity of f* makes that sample valid on a neighborhood. A finite subcover yields a finite rational set A with f*-eta<=g_A<=f* on Delta, where g_A(p)=max_{x in A}(p.x-f(x)). Define E_A=conv{(x,f(x)):x in A}+epi h. This is closed, being a compact hull plus a closed cone, and projects onto all R^d. It lies in epi f: the support representation with slopes in Delta gives f(x+v)<=f(x)+h(v), and convex combinations preserve epigraph membership. Let F_A be its finite convex lower boundary. Its conjugate is g_A on Delta and infinity elsewhere, by evaluation on the generators. Supporting-plane duality gives f<=F_A<=f+eta globally.

Every lower face projects to the convex hull of active rational sample positions plus the cone of active rational recession directions. A lower graph face projects injectively, and graph-face intersections project to face intersections. Thus the projected graph faces form a finite rational complex despite irrational lifted heights and slopes. F_A is genuine real PA and relative to the same actual gamma. No irrational maximum wall is asserted rational. Taking errors 2^-n and adding rational constants 4*2^-n gives decreasing approximants: each consecutive drop is at least 2^-n-2^(-n-1). They converge globally uniformly. Only after this construction is the granted completed raw operator used. R230 therefore gives genuine domain membership for every bounded-continuous affine envelope.

For a finite real-PA obstacle, its envelope is itself finite real PA on rational geometry. Pointedly refine the rational carrier. Each obstacle epigraph piece has finitely many lifted rational base vertices, exact lifted rational recession directions, and the vertical ray. Its bounded obstacle part has zero recession slope. The closed convex hull of all pieces equals the compact hull of their lifted vertices plus the cone of all listed rays. To add a ray to any hull point, mix a vanishing coefficient at a point tending to infinity along that ray; this proves the closed-hull identity. The hull lies above gamma-||u|| and below the obstacle. Its lower boundary is the greatest continuous convex minorant, hence the unrestricted envelope by R230. Its faces project rationally as above. A constant approximating sequence checks its genuine raw domain.

Finite affine contact uses raw recursion. At a noncontact envelope vertex, the granted PC strict-floor perturbation forces a nontrivial flat relation sum lambda_i d_i=0 and sum lambda_i h(d_i)=0. Choose a support ell of the convex homogeneous full-plane germ and set b=h-ell. Then b is nonnegative and subadditive, and every active b(d_i)=0. For an active nonzero rational d_j, the relation expresses -d_j as a nonnegative combination of other zero directions, so b(-d_j)=0. Subadditivity in both directions gives b(x+t d_j)=b(x) for every real t. The germ is affine along a nonzero rational line. Its linearity fan has common lineality and no vertices; the d-step raw product is zero. Refinement independence preserves this conclusion after artificial cuts. Every positive raw PA atom therefore lies on the contact set, and the exact integral is zero. No Alexandrov operator is substituted.

For the non-PA passage, independently reconstruct the needed legal-tree argument. For finite-valued F, let TF(x) be the infimum of F(x) and the weighted values over all printed legal PCCs at x. Starting with gamma+u, ||u||<=C, the iterates decrease between gamma-C and gamma+C. Finite sums commute with decreasing limits, and infima over iterate index and legal splits commute. The limit is a fixed point of T and hence PC. Every PC minorant lies below every iterate; the bounded-relative limit is itself a competitor, so it is the actual envelope.

Each iterate is an infimum over finite legal splitting-tree costs, by choosing finitely many child trees with distributed approximation errors. No-op leaves are allowed; each node has its own rational witnessing refinement. If H=gamma+c>=0 is proper, an e-optimal terminal probability nu satisfies integral H dnu<=H(x)+2C+e. Thus its mass above height R is at most (H(x)+2C+e)/R. Evaluate the same tree for v, ||v||<=C, then reverse u and v and let e decrease to zero. This gives |P(u)(x)-P(v)(x)|<=sup_{H<=R}|u-v|+2C(H(x)+2C)/R. Bounded local-uniform obstacle convergence therefore implies local-uniform envelope convergence. Bellman iterates receive no measure; leaf probabilities are PCC probabilities, not normalized MA measures.

The required measure continuity holds only on the existing genuine completion. For compact rational-PA psi supported in K, telescope two finite mixed tuples and use bounded primitive integration by parts. Granted same-reference DC auxiliaries express D_psi Z as a scaled difference of positive mixed products of mass M. Its support lies in K and its variation is at most L_psi=2M/(epsilon eta_psi). Hence |<psi,MA(a)-MA(b)>|<=L_psi sum_i sup_K|a_i-b_i|. Passing through global uniform approximants proves the same estimate for two already completed tuples. Completed local-uniform convergence to an already completed endpoint gives vague convergence. Compact-test density and the granted fixed-C all-tuple height bound supply tightness, then convergence against each bounded continuous test. For bounded locally convergent contact gaps, compact cutoffs pass the integrals; the two height tails contribute at most 4CK_C/T. This argument does not enlarge the operator domain.

Approximate any bounded continuous u locally uniformly by compactly supported rational-affine PA u_n with ||u_n||<=||u||+1/n. Compact cutoffs followed by finite rational norm bumps approximating positive and negative parts give these functions; uniform continuity on each compact support controls the error. This is not global uniform density in C_b. The new domain proof applies separately to every u_n and to u. Their finite-PA envelopes have zero contact. The reconstructed tree and genuine-domain continuity arguments pass those integrals to u, completing all affine non-PA and domain antecedents.

notes.summary: A positive complete tangent-plane subcycle with a transverse two-sided line obstructs every actual reference. Finite positive affine-plane arrangements satisfy all-continuous domain/contact exactly when their distinct planes are disjoint.
notes.detailedSummary: Rational coordinate forms annihilating the transverse line produce a flat ambient-convex jet with positive primitive raw mass. S272 realizes a genuinely measured finite-PA roof witness for each actual reference. Disjoint arrangements use n2; crossing arrangements fail already at finite PA. General singular and abstract/glued classifications remain open.
notes.text:
New geometric obstruction. Let X be a finite globally embedded positive balanced d-space. Suppose at a rational point v its weighted tangent cycle C_v contains c[Q], c>0, for a complete rational linear d-plane Q, with C_v-c[Q] explicitly effective and balanced. Suppose the tangent support contains a two-sided rational line L with Q intersect L={0}. Then every actual real-PA PC positive-growth reference has a bounded real-PA obstacle whose genuine finite-PA envelope has strictly negative raw contact integral. Support inclusion alone is not claimed to imply the subcycle hypothesis.

Choose a saturated basis of Q. Rational linear algebra extends its dual coordinate forms to ambient rational ell_1,...,ell_d vanishing on L, because Q and L are independent. Set h=sum_j |ell_j| on the tangent support. It is ambient-convex homogeneous rational PA and PC on a finite rational hyperplane refinement. It vanishes on both primitive directions of L, yielding a legal flat PCC at v.

The raw primitive calibration is explicit. On a complete saturated d-plane of weight c, let A be the restriction matrix of the forms. D_|ell| gives twice the positive primitive evaluation of ell times the saturated kernel cycle, from the two opposite inward normals. Rational scaling reduces to integral forms. The Euclidean algorithm changes an integral row to (g,0,...,0), with g its positive gcd, constructing the saturated kernel basis and primitive complement. Repeating a factor gives zero because its restriction to its kernel vanishes. For independent distinct forms, intersect saturated kernels successively. Each kernel basis extends by a primitive complement to the preceding lattice; the restriction matrix is triangular in these nested bases. The primitive evaluations multiply to |det A|, including all lattice indices. Each ordered distinct-factor product is 2^d|det A| delta_0. Expansion has d! such orders; repeated terms vanish by mixed symmetry. Thus the raw atom is c 2^d d!|det A|. If A is singular, a nonzero rational common kernel supplies lineality and the top product is zero. The factorial comes from expansion, not an appended normalization.

On Q the matrix is the identity. Cycle linearity and positivity on the effective balanced residual give m_0(h;C_v)>=c 2^d d!>0. Zero intermediate weights are allowed. S272 realizes this specified rational PC jet on its finite rational refinement by a genuine global relative real-PA F with the same germ C+t+delta h in every rational reference summand. Flatness survives, and its raw atom is delta^d m_0(h)>0. The granted roof construction gives u=F-gamma+(R-rho(x-v))_+, with actual unrestricted envelope F and exact integral -R delta^d m_0(h)<0. The flat boundary relation bounds competitors at v; radial chords bound rational roof points; shrinking rational simplices bound real points; outside the roof the obstacle equals F. Choose the roof small enough that v is its only mass atom. All measure and envelope antecedents are genuine finite PA, so this obstruction requires no assumed all-obstacle regularization.

A complete classification follows in the geometric sector X=union_i Q_i of finitely many distinct rational affine d-planes with cycle sum_i c_i[Q_i], c_i>0, saturated lattices, d>=1, and actual reference as above. Simultaneous envelope regularization and raw contact for every bounded continuous obstacle holds if and only if the planes are pairwise disjoint.

If two planes intersect, their rational equations admit a rational intersection point v. Choose a rational tangent direction a in the second plane but outside the first. L=R a is two-sided and transverse to the first tangent plane. At v the tangent cycle is the sum of the planes containing v, so the first plane has an effective balanced residual. The obstruction gives a genuine finite-PA negative-contact witness for every actual reference.

If the planes are disjoint, their pairwise distances are positive: their differences are closed affine subspaces avoiding zero. With finitely many planes, each is an open and closed component. Connected polyhedral cells and PCC incidences stay within one component. Envelopes are componentwise. Apply n2 to the reference on each plane. Finitely many decreasing approximations synchronize on common rational refinements, giving genuine global regularization. Raw locality and cycle addition sum the measures and the zero component contact integrals. At an intersecting arrangement point the obstruction has exact atom 2^d d! sum_{i:v in Q_i} c_i|det A_i|, with singular matrices contributing zero and at least one identity contribution positive.

This is an all-continuous classification of affine arrangements and a broader necessary obstruction, not the entire original classification. General singular/glued spaces, their envelope-domain membership, non-PA contact sufficiency, and complete structural reduction over all rational refinements remain OPEN. The literal integral-slope/rational-constant category remains separate: noncompact literal references have the granted regularity obstruction, and excluded endpoints receive no literal MA measure. No compact abstract-chart conclusion is inferred from this embedded argument.
